newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CR Beijing Land leads the H.K. market.
newsitem.headline: CR Beijing Land leads the H.K. market.

text.p: Newly listed China Resources Beijing Land Ltd led the Hong Kong market on Monday on keen buying which brokers said reflected interest in the development potential of its landbank and a positive view of its parent.
"The company's main attraction is its holding company's background," said Cliff Sum, China analyst at New China Hong Kong Securities.
The shares rose HK$0.275 to HK$4.325 on turnover of HK$356.79 million. The company was listed on Friday.
China Resources Enterprises is a subsidiary of China Resources Holdings Ltd, a major trading arm of China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.
China analysts said the share was looking a bit pricey.
At HK$4.325, the share was trading at a sizeable premium to its estimated net asset value (NAV) at the time of listing of HK$3.22.
Kerry Properties, also a newly listed China property play, was trading at a deep discount to its NAV, analysts said.
